_readme: Round 2 branches from the round-1 picks A (painterly), B (cel-shaded ink), G (flat vector), H (low-poly faceted). Baselines keep their round-1 codes; '2' = a variation; two-letter codes = hybrids. Same seed as round 1.
name: round2
title: Round 2: variations and hybrids of A, B, G, H
framing: single subject centered, entire subject visible, plain flat light grey background
palette: warm golden saturated palette, early frontier era
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, cropped, cut off, busy background, scenery, landscape, ground, environment, multiple separate objects, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, deformed

subjects.label: Moss Shrimp
subjects.prompt: a plump freshwater shrimp seen from the side, a true crustacean with a curved segmented body, fan-shaped tail fin, small front claws and two long antennae, soft green mossy shell, subtly alien wildlife
subjects.negative: centipede, millipede, scorpion, insect, worm, many legs

subjects.label: Oak Logs
subjects.prompt: a small stack of three cut oak logs with rough bark and pale end-grain rings

subjects.label: Unity Scout Set
subjects.prompt: Unity scout armor set shown as if worn on an invisible mannequin, the garments hold their worn three-dimensional shape with a hollow empty interior and an empty hood: hooded travel cloak, quilted tunic, leather belts and pouches, woven sash with folk-pattern embroidery, soft leather boots, natural dyed fabrics, humble communal earth-folk craftsmanship, no metal plating
subjects.negative: person, human, face, head, skin, hands, arms, body, mannequin, dress form, display stand, hanger, weapons, sword, spear, bow, gun

styles.label: Painterly (round-1 A)
styles.prompt: visible brushstrokes, soft blended gradients, storybook concept art
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, vector, flat color

styles.label: Painterly, crisp edges
styles.prompt: visible brushstrokes, soft blended gradients, crisp clean defined edges, thin dark outline around the silhouette, high readability
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, vector, blurry edges

styles.label: Cel-shaded bold ink (round-1 B)
styles.prompt: thick black ink outlines, flat color fills, hard-edged cel shadows, graphic novel style
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, soft gradients, painterly

styles.label: Cel-shaded, colored linework
styles.prompt: medium-weight colored lineart darker than the fill instead of black, two-tone hard cel shading with a single highlight, clean and bright
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, black outlines, painterly, gritty

styles.label: Flat vector (round-1 G)
styles.prompt: clean geometric shapes, minimal shading, crisp edges, simple bold forms
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, texture, brushstrokes, gradients

styles.label: Vector, bold outline + 2-tone
styles.prompt: bold uniform dark outline, flat colors with one hard shadow tone and one highlight tone, simplified geometric shapes, crisp edges
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, texture, brushstrokes, soft gradients

styles.label: Low-poly faceted (round-1 H)
styles.prompt: flat-shaded triangular facets, gem-like geometric planes, simple lighting
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, smooth surfaces, painterly, sketch

styles.label: Low-poly, soft lighting
styles.prompt: visible polygon facets with soft gradient lighting across them, warm rim light, subtle color variation per facet, polished stylized render
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, high-poly smooth surfaces, sketch

styles.label: Hybrid: painterly inside bold ink
styles.lead: painterly illustration game icon with bold ink outlines
styles.prompt: thick confident black ink contour lines, painted soft-shaded fills inside the lines, brush texture, comic cover art finish

styles.label: Hybrid: faceted flat vector
styles.lead: geometric faceted vector illustration game icon
styles.prompt: shapes built from flat-colored angular planes like cut paper or crystal, no gradients, crisp edges, clean bold silhouette
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, smooth 3d render, brushstrokes, soft gradients
